title: Evaluation of layered DAG nodes
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean DAG circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates have distinct arguments and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. Suppose no gate of $C$ is an OR gate, and let $x$ be a Boolean input assignment. For every $m$ with $0\le m\le |C.\mathrm{gates}|$ and every node $u$ in layer $m$, the value of $u$ in the layered circuit associated to $C$ is the Boolean value, encoded in $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$, of the corresponding node in the execution of $C$; a node index outside the execution’s value list is assigned false.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
No gate is an OR gate
u is a node in layer m
